{{Quote|The planet Skine resisted the Hegemony's demands to surrender. Hammer Station reduced its capital city to ashes two hours ago.|Satele Shan|<ref name="TOR:IFHS" />}}
'''Skine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TOR:IFHS" /> located in the [[Skine sector/Legends|Skine sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the location of the [[Skine Bounty Hunter College]].<ref name="GG10" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the xenophobic and expansionist faction known as the [[Advozse Hegemony]] used the prototype [[Hammer Station]] battle station to [[Bombardment of Skine|bombard]] Skine's [[Skine's capital city|capital city]] when the planet refused to surrender to the Hegemony.<ref name="TOR:IFHS" />
